_readme: Copy to config/update.json. EVERY key is optional.
Paths are discovered when omitted: scripts/update-git.sh resolves each
setting as env var > this file > the running canvas-server.service >
the deployment's .env > a built-in default, and finds its own checkout
(or the unit's WorkingDirectory, or the service user's home) as the root.
State a path here only to override that — a stale canvasRoot/canvasUser
is how a box updates one tree while using another tree's paths.
channel: dev -> branch dev, prod -> branch main (unless branch is set).
